coaching.headline: Every Fangtooth, both Primes and nine structures to two. A clean fucking demolition, with Murdock and Grux carving up the damage dealers the only stain.
coaching.team: The team took every Fangtooth, the Mini Prime, the Orb Prime, the Genesis Core and all three Seedlings, and broke nine structures while losing two. The enemy led on kills early, the team drew level at seven apiece and never trailed again, finishing twenty-seven to seventeen. Each of the four won fights was followed shortly by a structure or an objective. The only allied structures lost were two outer towers, shortly after Grux killed Lt. Belica and Sparrow.

focus.title: Find Grux before the damage steps up
focus.action: When Grux has not shown on the map, Lt. Belica and Sparrow stay within reach of Steel or Adele before stepping forward. Every Grux kill landed on Sparrow, Lt. Belica or Bayle, and a pull or a drag into a stun is a shit way to die.

16.9.call: Steel killed Greystone, Sparrow killed Dekker, Grux killed Sparrow, Gideon killed Adele, and Lt. Belica killed Grux, Murdock and Gideon. The fight went 5-2 and two enemy outer towers fell shortly after. That is the template: win the fight, then hit the structures.

18.4.call: Grux killed Lt. Belica and Sparrow with no enemy deaths. The team took an enemy inner tower soon after, and two allied outer towers fell in the same stretch, the only structures the enemy took all game. That stretch went two structures to one against the team.

24.2.call: Lt. Belica killed Greystone and Grux and Steel killed Gideon, with no allied deaths. The fight went 3-0, Lt. Belica killed Dekker shortly after, an enemy inhibitor fell and the Orb Prime went to the team soon after that.

16f28434-561f-4f23-9454-40321f4a1ef3: Goldilocks324 pulled a proper support shift: the most wards placed in the game, the most assists in the game, a hand in more than a third of the team's kills and the second-most damage mitigated on the team.

Adele was the team's first death in three fights, twice to Murdock. Opening snack is not peel, so when Murdock or Gideon is in range, Adele has Iron Rose's damage reduction running before Imperial Lash dashes in.
00196e12-6345-4794-a4cf-38569b3aad4f: RoboDracula did the jungle job: the second-most objective damage in the game, the most healing on the team, ward placements well above the recorded Bayle norm, and every Fangtooth and both Primes went to the team.

Hero damage sat well under the recorded Bayle norm, a big angry swordsman tickling people. In fights, Bayle lands Skull Crusher on Murdock or Grux first, so the armor shred is up before Sparrow starts shooting.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Sparrow led the whole game in objective damage, cleared the most enemy wards on the team and killed Grux three times. Big objective numbers and real vision work from the carry seat. Keep that shit.

Six deaths, the most on the team and above the recorded Sparrow norm, with hero damage well under norm. Murdock got three, first blood included, so when Murdock activates Hot Pursuit, Sparrow vanishes with Heightened Senses before trading back.
10edbf65-457d-48d0-9151-9df5b4fcb40a: Willy Guggenheim was a fucking menace on Lt. Belica: the most kills and gold in the game, the second-most hero damage, three kills in the largest fight of the game, and Gideon never killed Lt. Belica.
Ten kills with three deaths is the bar next game. Void Drone drains nearby mana and Neural Disruptor hits harder on missing mana, so Lt. Belica drops the drone near Gideon before firing the ultimate.
b0da1dff-7b73-4b93-8c71-7b29a4619ed1: negreoleo was the best player in this lobby: the most hero damage in the game, by far the most damage mitigated, one death, and Greystone dead to Steel four times without a kill in return. An absolute wrecking ball.

One death while eating the most damage of any ally is the standard now. Murdock got that lone kill, so when Murdock starts shooting at Steel or the backline, Force Shield goes up between Murdock and the target first.

matchup: Dekker stuns, slows and blocks heroes, and built Tainted Charm, so healing near Dekker was cut.
Murdock and Gideon each killed Adele twice.
The allied duo died three times before the ten-minute mark and the enemy duo once.
build: Dawnstar rewards rooting and basic-attacking heroes by stacking a reduction to their damage.
Tainted Charm targets Grux, the biggest healer in the game; Hexbound Bracers suits facing Murdock.
eternal: Cannibalism suits the most assists in the game; Voracity sits awkwardly beside Sanctification's diminishing minion gold.
Regenerative Tissue is the first-minor alternative, trading kill sustain for recovery between fights.
Festering Wounds is not needed: four of the five allies already carried anti-heal.
augment: Court of Roses gives the nearest ally a barrier, with obvious users in Sparrow and Lt. Belica.
Seeds of Dominion is the alternative, trading ally protection for more catch.
crest: Sanctification's Safeguard shields and adds tenacity, shortening Dekker's stun and Murdock's root.
The raised ward cap fits Adele placing the most wards in the game.
improvement: Gideon, a magical damage dealer, killed Adele twice and she had no magical armor, so compare Xenia for the Greaves slot.
Xenia adds both armors and an ally shield, at the cost of Gaussian Greaves' double-jump slow.
Raiment of Renewal over Hexbound Bracers is the other option; a won game proves neither swap.

matchup: Grux pulls, drags and stuns, heals per hero hit, and had the most healing in the game.
His Tainted Rounds cut Dire Howl's heal and Solstice, and Basilisk shreds armor.
Bayle and Grux killed each other once apiece.
build: Malady, Tainted Trident, Alternator and Solstice bring sustain and armor.
Tainted Trident has targets in Grux and Greystone, but hero damage sat well under the recorded Bayle norm.
eternal: Immaculate and Berserk pay at opposite ends of the health bar, and Bayle took the second-most damage of any ally.
Prima Donna is the second-minor alternative, targeting the low hero damage at a survival cost.
augment: Swift Strikes pairs with weaving Skull Crusher, Cursed Edge and Dire Howl between attacks.
Frenzied Fighter is the alternative, trading the weave for a low-health brawl.
crest: Brutallax cleanses and grants heavy tenacity, answering Gideon's root, Dekker's Stasis Bomb and Grux's stuns.
The extension rewards staying on one target.
improvement: Bayle built none of the winning core of Manta Scythe, Ashbringer and Onixian Quiver.
Three other allies carried anti-heal, so compare Manta Scythe over Tainted Trident for the hero-damage gap.
With the second-most objective damage and deaths under the norm, the jungle job got done either way.

matchup: Murdock, their top hero damage, killed Sparrow three times including first blood; Sparrow killed him twice.
Dekker stuns and blocks, and Grux also killed Sparrow three times.
build: Every completed item adds critical chance, and Tainted Rounds targets Grux, the biggest healer in the game.
None of the four adds armor against physical damage from Murdock and Grux.
eternal: Weald, Forage and Wind-Rider fit, with Heightened Senses triggering Wind-Rider.
With the most team deaths, Natural Resistance is the first-minor alternative against Static Trap and Stasis Bomb, trading Forage's income.
augment: Endless Hunt resets cooldowns and stacks penetration on takedowns, fed by seven kills and three assists.
Sun Shards is the alternative, trading the resets for damage spread across grouped targets.
crest: Liberator's cleanse directly answers Murdock's Static Trap root and Dekker's slows when pressed in time.
Its lifesteal also feeds Terminus's overheal shield.
improvement: Sparrow built none of the winning core of Storm Breaker, Sky Splitter and Spectra.
Storm Breaker is the direct comparison for Lightning Hawk: same trigger, chaining on-hit lightning instead of a slow.
A won game does not prove the current build is the problem.

matchup: Gideon's mana items gave Void Drone's drain and Neural Disruptor's missing-mana damage a target.
Lt. Belica killed Gideon three times and Gideon never killed her; Grux killed her twice and Murdock once.
build: Seismic Assault into Void Bomb or Neural Disruptor is the natural sequence for Noxia.
Dekker's Unbroken Will was the only enemy magical armor, so Caustica had little to bite on.
eternal: Aion pays with the second-most hero damage in the game; Runic Focus fits the mana build.
Sacrifice is the first-minor alternative, suiting the most kills in the game, trading the river-buff power.
augment: Combat Veteran's faster levels feed Innovation's max-rank bonus sooner.
Pulsefire Rounds or Devastating Bombs trade the experience for damage.
crest: Soulbearer's Anima pays while spells land on heroes.
Epoch is the draft alternative to wait out Grux or Murdock, trading the lifesteal and speed for time.
improvement: With the most kills and gold in the game, the build is a sound keep.
Against one completed enemy magical armor item, Caustica is the slot to compare.
Magnify or Timewarp would trade Caustica's penetration for survival against Grux or faster cooldowns.

matchup: Greystone built armor shred and anti-heal that bite on a tank.
Steel killed Greystone four times and Greystone finished without a kill; Murdock got Steel's only death.
build: Tainted Guard punishes basic attackers like Grux, the biggest healer, and Murdock.
The stack came with by far the most damage mitigated in the game.
eternal: Nihil, From the Abyss and Adaptive Plating suit a frontliner who took the most damage of any ally.
Inescapable is the second-minor alternative against Greystone's, Gideon's and Grux's leaps and dashes, trading Adaptive Plating's armor for a slow.
augment: Heavy Metal scales with armor, and Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard and Aegis Of Agawar all raise it.
Adaptive Force is the alternative when blocking Murdock's shots matters more; Bulldozer trades on-hit damage for a safer engage.
crest: Saphir's Mantle rewards activating inside a fight rather than before one.
Steel had the most hero damage in the game.
improvement: With the most hero damage in the game and one death, the current build is a sound keep.
Flux Matrix, the one skipped core item, would amplify magical damage for both Lt. Belica and Steel.
It costs Aegis Of Agawar's health and armor, which also feeds Heavy Metal.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Grux Crush (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Our engage/CC: Bayle Kingslayer (knockback), Lt. Belica Neural Disruptor (silence 0.5s). Our kills come from landing burst INSIDE that CC window — whoever lands it, the rest must follow up immediately.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Skull Crusher gap-close → Dire Howl slow → Cursed Edge → Kingslayer knockback dash, Berserk at low HP
ourKits.winCondition: engage, drop low into Berserk and out-brawl
ourKits.playWith: follow-up while he commits the dive
ourKits.playAgainst: his Berserk rewards low HP — burst him fully or disengage; anti-heal helps

ourKits.combo: Piercing Shot poke → Heightened Senses AS → Hail of Arrows zone → Inner Fire ult
ourKits.winCondition: ramp Relentless + AS and sustained-DPS the front down
ourKits.playWith: heavy peel — she's immobile and pure DPS
ourKits.playAgainst: she has zero escape — hard-engage her and she dies first

ourKits.combo: Seismic Assault knockup → Void Bomb → Neural Disruptor silence ult, Void Drone mana drain
ourKits.winCondition: knock up + silence a target and burst with missing-HP scaling
ourKits.playAgainst: dodge Seismic Assault; she's immobile — dive when ult is down

ourKits.combo: Bull Rush knockback → Force Shield wall → Shield Slam knockup+stun ult, Shield Bash %hp
ourKits.winCondition: peel the carry with walls/knockups or engage with Shield Slam
ourKits.playWith: a carry he can wall for and peel
ourKits.playAgainst: his Force Shield blocks projectiles — reposition around it; bait Shield Slam

enemyKits.combo: Stasis Bomb stun → Photon Disruptor slow → Containment Fence wall → Ion Strike slow ult
enemyKits.winCondition: lock a target with stun + fence and let the team collapse
enemyKits.passive: Rocket Boots mobility, refreshed by abilities
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun/fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb; the fence zones — flank around it

enemyKits.combo: Static Trap root → Buckshot → Hot Pursuit AS → Long Arm of the Law global snipe
enemyKits.winCondition: trap for the root, then out-range with Shots Fired and finish with the global ult
enemyKits.passive: every 5th basic is a long-range bonus shot
enemyKits.playWith: frontline/peel to protect his low mobility
enemyKits.playAgainst: almost no escape — engage past the trap and he dies

enemyKits.combo: Assault The Gates leap → Make Way armor shred → Sacred Oath empowered basic → Stone Forged Soul stasis ult
enemyKits.winCondition: front-line aggressively and reset the fight with the stasis heal
enemyKits.playWith: a team that fights while he soaks and stasis-resets
enemyKits.playAgainst: don't waste burst into his stasis — wait it out; anti-heal cuts the ult heal

enemyKits.combo: Void Breach slow → Cosmic Rift → Black Hole on the grouped enemies
enemyKits.winCondition: land Black Hole / Cosmic Rift on a clumped team for AoE burst
enemyKits.passive: an ability-empowered basic tethers a target for bonus damage
enemyKits.playWith: hard engage that clumps enemies into his Black Hole
enemyKits.playAgainst: immobile with long cooldowns — dodge the skillshots and dive him once Black Hole is down

enemyKits.combo: Smash 'n Grab pull → Crush knockup → Warlord's Challenge stun → bleed-stacked basics
enemyKits.winCondition: land the pull→knockup chain to lock a target while bleed and AS shred them
enemyKits.passive: basics stack a bleed for sustained damage
enemyKits.playWith: follow-up burst inside his knockup/stun window
enemyKits.playAgainst: telegraphed engage — bait Crush/Pull, then punish; kite his slow start

fedBy: Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
lines: Lead story: Stayed alive, joined every fight, and each takedown sped up the ultimate. In 69% of the team's kills (more than 92% of Murdock carry players this patch) and died 4 times (fewer than about 66% of them). Lotus turned 11 takedowns into ability haste, so Long Arm of the Law came back every ~89s instead of 120s.
Lesson: takedowns were the fuel. Each one Murdock touched shortened Long Arm of the Law, so feeding early made it come back faster (about 88.9s late); fight right after Long Arm of the Law is spent.
Long Arm of the Law at rank 2: 120s base, about 88.9s by the end (26% shorter) from 35 ability haste: Tainted Trident 10, Lotus 25.
11 takedowns (8 kills, 3 assists) fed: Lotus (Eternal).
Murdock dealt 21,913 hero damage, 25% of their team's, with +197 physical power from items.

Penetration: Tainted Trident 11, Vanquisher 12; against Sparrow (level 16: about 96 physical armor, 73 after penetration; took 9,564 physical damage from heroes, 65% of all hero damage they took) and Adele (level 15: about 169 physical armor, 146 after penetration; took 13,020 physical damage from heroes, 56% of all hero damage they took) that is about 13% and 9% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Lightning Hawk (item): While moving or landing Basic Attacks: Generate stacks of Momentum. At 100 stacks empower your next Basic Attack On-Hit. Deal 40 (+20%) Damage. Slows by 20% for 0.75s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.
Tainted Trident (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Blighted Unit: Deal 3 (+6%)% additional Damage.
Sky Splitter (item): On Successful Basic Attacks: Deal 5% of Target's Current Health as Damage On-Hit. Reduced to 3.5% for Ranged Heroes. Minimum of 12 Damage.
Lotus (Eternal): Every 2 minutes and every Takedown randomly grants +1% Damage, +4 Ability Haste, +0.75% Move Speed, or +1.25% Max Health.
Masterpiece (Eternal minor): Kills grant 4% Bonus Damage and 5% Movement Speed for 12s, stacking up to 5 times.
Prima Donna (Eternal minor): Deal 10% increased damage to Enemy Heroes, but take 6% increased damage from all sources.

Sustain: 14% lifesteal; Tainted Trident: On dealing Physical Damage: Reduce the Target's Healing by 45% for 3s.; Liberator: Cleanse all Debuffs. Gain a 80 (+100%) Shield for 2.5s.; 1,077 healing recorded.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 3 effects on one trigger: Tainted Trident, Sky Splitter, Liberator.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 2 effects on one trigger: Lightning Hawk, Sky Splitter.
Countered? 3 of the 5 players Murdock killed built physical armor (Adele, Bayle, Steel). Anti-heal on Adele, Bayle, Sparrow, Steel. We killed Murdock 4 times.
Copy it? Lotus: 52.1% in 119 Murdock carry games, above the hero's 48.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Murdock's takedowns fed Long Arm of the Law: every kill or assist made it come back sooner. Deny early takedowns and fight right after Long Arm of the Law is used.

lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,121 hero damage a minute, more than 75% of Lt. Belica mid players this patch (29% of the team's). Penetration did the work: Grux took about 34% more magical damage than their armor allowed (estimate).
Neural Disruptor at rank 3: 85s base, about 66.4s by the end (22% shorter) from 28 ability haste: Noxia 20, Soulbearer 8.
Lt. Belica dealt 32,498 hero damage, 29% of their team's, with +500 magical power from items.

Penetration: Combustion 9, Wraith Leggings 11, Caustica ignores 35%; against Grux (level 15: about 55 magical armor, 16 after penetration; took 11,429 magical damage from heroes, 42% of all hero damage they took) and Gideon (level 15: about 44 magical armor, 9 after penetration; took 14,606 magical damage from heroes, 70% of all hero damage they took) that is about 34% and 33% more damage (estimate: percent penetration taken before flat).
Combustion (item): On dealing Ability Damage: Deal 50 (+18%) Damage to the Target and nearby Enemies.
Noxia (item): Deal 6% of Target's Maximum Health as bonus Damage.
Caustica (item): On dealing Ability Damage to a Hero: While they are above 50% Health. For every point of Bonus Magical Armor they possess. Deal 0.2% more Damage.
Wraith Leggings (item): Against Heroes below 40% Health: Abilities deal 12% bonus Magical Damage.
Aion (Eternal): Casting a spell grants 1 Mana Regeneration for 8s (stacks 5x). Spells also grant gold equal to 6% of damage dealt to Enemy Heroes.
Sustain: Soulbearer: Gain a 100 (+35) (+6%) Shield for 8s. Gain 20% Magical Lifesteal and 10% Movement Speed for 8s.; 1,670 healing recorded.

Lesson: Lt. Belica's penetration cut through: Grux took about 34% more magical damage than their armor alone allows (estimate: at level 15 their armor was about 55, about 16 after 20 flat + 35% penetration).

Stack (Every ability hit set off): 4 effects on one trigger: Combustion, Noxia, Caustica, Wraith Leggings. Lt. Belica has 4 damaging abilities (Void Bomb, Seismic Assault, Void Drone hit an area, so one cast sets them off on several heroes), and 28 ability haste brought them back 22% sooner: more casts, more triggers.
Countered? 1 of the 5 players Lt. Belica killed built magical armor (Dekker). We killed Lt. Belica 3 times.
Copy it? Aion (Bottomless Vial + Runic Focus): 53.5% in 172 Lt. Belica midlane games, above the hero's 51.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

steel.loadout: Nihil (From the Abyss + Adaptive Plating), augment Heavy Metal, crest Saphir's Mantle
fedBy: Nihil (Eternal): Damage a hero to gain Doom for 3s. Doom grants 1 Physical Power, 2 Magical Power, 1 Physical Armor & 1 Magical Armor for every 3s it persists. On level-up or Takedown, the stats Doom grants are permanently increased by 20%.
lines: Lead story: Damage well above normal. 1,377 hero damage a minute, more than 98% of Steel offlane players this patch (36% of the team's). The damage came from Fire Blossom, Fist Of Razuul, Tainted Guard.
Shield Slam at rank 3: 95s base, about 66.4s by the end (30% shorter) from 43 ability haste: Fist Of Razuul 20, Tainted Guard 8, Raiment of Renewal 15.
13 takedowns (6 kills, 7 assists) fed: Nihil (Eternal).
Steel dealt 39,935 hero damage, 36% of their team's, with +0 magical power from items.
Fire Blossom (item): Burn nearby Enemy Units: Deals 15 (+1%) Damage each second.Firestorm - When Heatwave damages a Target: Deals 5% more damage each second, up to 40%.
Fist Of Razuul (item): When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.
Fist Of Razuul (item): Deal 25% increased damage to Minions.
Tainted Guard (item): On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.

Saphir's Mantle (crest): Increase your Size and Max Health by 10% for 6s. Deal 60 (+1.25%) Damage to nearby Heroes. After the duration, permanently increase your Max Health by 20% of the Damage dealt.
Adaptive Plating (Eternal minor): Taking damage grants matching Armor (1% per hit, stacks 10x).
Heavy Metal (augment): Heavy Punches and Shield Bash deal Bonus Magical Damage On-Hit equal to 10% of your Total Physical Armor and Magical Armor.

Sustain: Fist Of Razuul: When dealing or receiving damage: For the next 3s, generate a stack each second. Upon reaching 4 stacks, Empower your next Basic Attack.; Tainted Guard: On being hit by a Basic Attack: Reduce the Source's Healing by 45% for 3s. Apply a Bleed dealing 30 (+30%) Damage over 3s.; 5,884 healing recorded.
Toughness: +2430 health, +113 physical armor, +5 magical armor, +20% tenacity; took 46,174 damage, mitigated 75,095, died 1 times.
Stack (Every basic attack set off): 3 effects on one trigger: Fist Of Razuul, Tainted Guard, Heavy Metal.
Stack (Healing off the damage): 2 effects on one trigger: Fist Of Razuul, Tainted Guard.
Countered? 0 of the 3 players Steel killed built magical armor. Anti-heal on Dekker, Murdock, Greystone, Gideon, Grux. We killed Steel 1 time.
Copy it? Nihil (From the Abyss + Adaptive Plating): 53.2% in 188 Steel offlane games, above the hero's 49.6%. Proven this patch: worth copying.

card.lesson: Shield Slam came back about every 66s instead of 95s by the end (30% shorter). Count it, and take fights while it is down.
